message:
As we think about preparedness, it’s comforting to know there are resources out there to help us create our own plans. By taking a little time to map out what we would do in various situations, we can turn a potentially stressful experience into a cozy family event. 🏡

Gather the family, sip some tea, and brainstorm together! Not only does this bring us closer, but it also gives everyone a sense of security and teamwork. 

What’s your favorite tip for making preparedness feel less daunting and more like a fun family project?
